geometric_error_rule: Pair a true unit horizontal/vertical L in the empty grid with the unit L adjacent to BC. Proposed error assigns the full1x1 cell area1 to triangle ABC via its shared diagonal BC, forgetting that the equivalent adjacent half-cell triangle has area1/2.
material_difference: Old v01 colored the entire ABC contour red, presetD, finalsB/D. New design leaves all original triangle edges black and draws four1pt unit projection spans between EXISTING dots; it supplies an actual one-cell area source and receiver instead of whole-triangle salience. PresetD is retained prospectively for the new full-cell/half-triangle rule, not a relabel of the old one-hit.

primary_math_proof.derivation: 20 original dots form a5-column4-row unit grid. A=(0,0),B=(3,2),C=(4,3), not B=(4,2) or C=(5,3). |3*3-2*4|/2=1/2. For the auxiliary comparison cell D=(4,2), BC=sqrt2; A and D are on opposite sides of x-y=1 at distance1/sqrt2. Thus ABC and DBC each have area1/2, whereas the full one-by-one cell has area1. Only B gives1/2.
primary_math_proof.target_identity: ABC stays the single labeled original triangle; D is only an existing unlabeled grid dot. No new point is drawn.
